data.disagreement_analysis: The first model (qwen) encountered an LLMResponseError when auditing .SRCINFO, resulting in an inconclusive file verdict and thus an inconclusive package verdict. The second model (deepseek) successfully audited .SRCINFO and all other files, finding them safe.
coverage_issues: qwen model failed to evaluate .SRCINFO due to an LLM API error (LLMResponseError).
learnings: The audit tool should implement automatic retries for transient LLM API errors to prevent a single file's evaluation failure from downgrading the entire package verdict to inconclusive, especially for non-executable metadata files like .SRCINFO.
